As of my last update, Bitcoin is approximately **$92,500**.

However, because the price of Bitcoin changes every second, you should check a live tracker for the most accurate current value. Here are the top sources:

1.  **[CoinMarketCap](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/)**
2.  **[CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin)**
3.  **[Google Finance](https://www.google.com/finance/quote/BTC-USD)** (Search "BTC price")
4.  **[Binance](https://www.binance.com/en/price/bitcoin)** or **[Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/price/bitcoin)**
